title: 第263章  苍云宗宝库
slug: 人在镇魔司红词加身只杀不渡
content_zh:
赤红晶芒贯穿天地，与那柄斩落的漆黑巨剑在半空中轰然相撞。
落尘剑域的剑意与开天之力激烈碰撞，将整座苍云宗上空的云海撕成两半。
僵持了不过一息，漆黑巨剑的剑锋上便炸开无数裂纹。
赤红晶芒贯穿了漆黑巨剑，将其彻底轰碎。
落尘剑域被破，刚准备逃离的楚落尘双眼爆瞪，随后猛地喷出一口血箭。
落尘剑域是他以本命剑意浸淫了数十年的绝学，以落尘古剑为引，将方圆数百丈的天地之势化为剑域。
然而陆渊那一击不仅贯穿了漆黑巨剑，更将落尘剑域的核心一并碾碎。
还没等他反应过来，一道红芒极速袭来，脚下剑罡炸裂，整个人被狠狠钉入大坑之中。
一时间，整座苍云宗上下皆是一震。
不可能！
绝对不可能！
地坑中，楚落尘咽下口中腥甜，心头暗暗叫苦。
本来他看着情况不对，就打算趁着陆渊刚斩杀段苍云的空隙，以落尘剑域争取些时间，赶紧逃离此地。
不曾想，对方不仅手段强悍，竟连他的剑域都能正面轰碎。
刚才那一道晶矛，换作是边地四宗任何一位武者，没有虚境修为都休想正面硬撼。
便是段苍云全盛时期全力出剑，也休想一剑劈碎他的落尘剑域。
但是这小子才二十出头啊！
楚落尘差点没把牙咬碎，枯瘦的身形自地缝中拔出，打算再度御剑逃遁。
无他，就从刚才的交手来看，他绝对不会是陆渊的对手，再拖下去只有死路一条。
然而他才刚见天日，便看到一道人影裹挟着狂风降临，直接杀到了他面前。

致命的威胁袭上楚落尘心头，他来不及多想，骤然提起体内残存的剑意，张口一吐，便是漫天剑罡。
身为落剑山山主，他修行剑道近百年，深知此刻若是再不拼命，势必会死在这里。
求饶已无用，段苍云的下场就是前车之鉴，还不如凭借自己的剑道修为搏得一线生机。
陆渊周身涌现金刚不坏的金光，前冲的势头不减反增，拉开拳架，凶悍地轰出一拳。
拳罡如虹，裹挟着呼啸的天地之势。
轰然之间，那席卷天地的剑罡猛地碎裂开来，暴露出一位神情错愕的清瘦老者。
紧接着，一记重拳砸在他脸上。
浩瀚的摧山之力袭来，楚落尘的身形暴退出去数十丈，沿途建筑倒塌的声音不绝于耳。
直到烟尘散去，他的身上已是大片破损，虽整体还算完整，也看得出伤势不轻。
楚落尘口鼻溢血，心中更是惊骇万分。
他的剑法早已修至大成，刚才那一拳，对方竟然靠肉身硬扛了他的剑罡？
这怎么可能？
他呼吸急促，不由得怀疑此人是妖魔的转世。
然而他并没有太多思考的时间。
陆渊的脚步声震耳欲聋，连带着整座苍云宗都在不断摇晃，似乎是在积蓄着恐怖力道。
接下来的攻击有多么恐怖，楚落尘想都不敢想。
他看着再度袭来的身影，猛地催动落尘剑法最后的杀招。
万剑归尘。
被击飞的落尘古剑在剑诀牵引下骤然飞回，剑身上的裂纹中迸射出刺目剑光。
古剑自行解体，化作万千道细如牛毛的剑丝。

每一缕剑丝都是楚落尘以本命剑意温养了数十年的剑罡，锋锐程度足以刺穿虚境妖王的防御。
万千剑丝如暴雨般倾泻而出，裹挟着落尘剑法特有的绵长诡异之势，从四面八方朝陆渊绞杀而去。
剑丝所过之处，空气被割裂出无数白痕，地面碎石被剑意扫过，瞬间化为齑粉。
陆渊前冲的势头不减反增。
金刚不坏的金芒在皮肤下疯狂流转，在周身交织成一层不可撼动的壁垒。
万千剑丝刺在他身上，发出密集如骤雨般的金铁交击之声，却连一道白印都未能留下。
下一刻，拳罡砸在楚落尘胸口，剑意护体入瓷片骤然炸裂。
楚落尘口喷鲜血，被这一拳轰得倒飞出去，半截身子埋在废墟里，意识迷离，气若游丝。
他双眼死死盯着陆渊的身影，口中发出含混不清的嘶哑。
“不可能……”
落尘剑法以诡异莫测著称，万剑归尘更是其中杀伤力最强的一式。
陆渊却根本不避。
那些剑影在他身上连一道白印都没留下。
陆渊踏步而来，从铁壁堡到苍云宗，从石破天到段苍云，再到现在将楚落尘打得重伤濒死。
边地四宗，至此已去其三。
他抬起手，楚落尘的身躯在灰雾中化作残骸。
这位落剑山之主和段苍云一样，终是为他们的傲慢付出了代价。
无声无息间，苍云岭上空的剑阵云海彻底消散。
整座山门暴露在日光之下，满目疮痍。
剑堂坍塌了大半，广场上跪满了失魂落魄的弟子。

陆渊将段苍云的腰牌收入手中，目光扫过这片废墟。
石破天已死，落剑山的楚落尘和苍云宗的段苍云一并交代在这里。
现在还剩下的，只有飞星谷。
柳星枢虚境四层，修为在四宗宗主中最低，但最狡猾，最擅长见风使舵。
不过厉震岳之前说过，柳星枢最擅长的便是在夹缝中周旋。
今日之后，边地已经没有夹缝了。
飞星谷之事，完全可以交由当地驻所处置。
苍云宗宝库的入口就在掌教剑堂废墟下方。
以宗主令牌为钥，神识为引，便可开启。
他按照令牌中封存的剑意指引，将灵力注入令牌。
下一刻，剑堂废墟深处传来一阵沉闷的机括转动声。
数丈石门缓缓洞开，一股独属于天材地宝的苍凉气息扑面而来。
段苍云这些年经营苍云宗，宝库中的积蓄比铁壁堡更加丰厚。
成排的剑诀秘录、堆积如山的灵石、数十柄以苍云岭特产的苍云玄铁铸造的上品长剑。
不过这些东西对陆渊来说用处不大，倒是可以一并移交给定安驻所充公。
他的神识在宝库中扫过，很快便在最深处感应到了一股气息。
宝库尽头是一座以阵法封存的小型寒泉。
泉心悬浮着一枚冰蓝色的晶莹果实，果皮晶莹剔透，能清晰看到其中脉络纹路。
content_en:
The red crystal light penetrated the sky and the earth, and collided with the fallen black sword in mid-air.
The sword intent of Luochen Sword Domain collided fiercely with the power of Kaitian, tearing the sea of ​​clouds above the entire Cangyun Sect into two halves.
The stalemate lasted for no more than a breath, and countless cracks exploded on the blade of the pitch-black giant sword.
The red crystal light penetrated the dark giant sword and completely shattered it.
Luochen's sword domain was broken. Chu Luochen's eyes widened as he was about to escape, and then he suddenly spat out a blood arrow.
The Luochen Sword Domain is a secret skill that he has been immersed in for decades with his natal sword intention. Using the Luochen Ancient Sword as a guide, he turns the power of heaven and earth with a radius of hundreds of feet into a sword domain.
However, Lu Yuan's blow not only penetrated the dark giant sword, but also crushed the core of Luochen Sword Domain.
Before he could react, a red light struck at extremely high speed, the sword under his feet exploded, and his whole body was severely nailed into the pit.
For a moment, the entire Cangyun Sect was shaken.
impossible!
Absolutely impossible!
In the pit, Chu Luochen swallowed the sweet taste in his mouth and secretly complained in his heart.
Originally, when he saw something was wrong, he planned to take advantage of the gap between Lu Yuan and Duan Cangyun to buy some time with Luochen Sword Domain and escape from this place quickly.
Unexpectedly, the opponent was not only powerful, but could even smash his sword field to pieces.
That crystal spear just now, if it were replaced by any warrior from the four border sects, without the cultivation of the virtual realm, there would be no way he could challenge it head-on.
Even if Duan Cangyun was in his prime and he used all his strength to draw his sword, he would never be able to crush his Luochen Sword Territory with one sword.
But this guy is only in his early twenties!
Chu Luochen almost gritted his teeth and pulled out his skinny figure from the crack in the ground, planning to escape with his sword again.
Without him, judging from the previous confrontation, he would definitely not be Lu Yuan's opponent, and any further delay would lead to death.
However, as soon as he saw the sky, he saw a figure coming with a strong wind and killing directly in front of him.
The fatal threat hit Chu Luochen's mind. He didn't have time to think about it. He suddenly raised the remaining sword intent in his body and opened his mouth to spit out the sword energy that filled the sky.
As the master of Luojian Mountain, he has practiced swordsmanship for nearly a hundred years, and he knows that if he doesn't fight hard now, he will definitely die here.
It is useless to beg for mercy. Duan Cangyun's fate is a lesson to others. It is better to rely on his own swordsmanship to fight for a chance of survival.
An indestructible golden light appeared all over Lu Yuan's body, and his forward momentum increased instead of decreasing. He opened his fist and punched fiercely.
The fist is like a rainbow, carrying the roaring power of heaven and earth.
Suddenly, the sword that swept through the world suddenly shattered, revealing a thin old man with a stunned expression.
Then, a heavy punch hit him in the face.
The vast mountain-destroying power struck, and Chu Luochen's figure burst out tens of feet. The sound of buildings collapsing along the way was heard endlessly.
When the smoke and dust dissipated, his body was completely damaged. Although the whole body was still intact, it was obvious that the injuries were serious.
Chu Luochen's mouth and nose were bleeding, and he was even more horrified.
His swordsmanship has been perfected for a long time. In that punch just now, the opponent actually used his physical body to withstand his sword?
How is this possible?
He was breathing rapidly, and he couldn't help but suspect that this man was the reincarnation of a demon.
However, he didn't have much time to think.
The sound of Lu Yuan's footsteps was deafening, and the entire Cangyun Sect was shaking continuously, as if it was accumulating terrifying power.
Chu Luochen couldn't even imagine how terrifying the next attack would be.
He looked at the figure that was attacking again and suddenly activated the final killing move of Luo Chen's sword technique.
Thousands of swords return to dust.
The ancient Luochen sword that was knocked away suddenly flew back under the pull of the sword technique, and a dazzling sword light burst out from the cracks on the sword.
The ancient sword disintegrated on its own and turned into thousands of sword threads as thin as ox hair.
Every strand of the sword is a sword that Chu Luochen has cultivated for decades with his native sword intention. It is sharp enough to pierce the defense of the demon king in the virtual realm.
Thousands of sword threads poured out like a torrential rain, carrying the long and strange momentum unique to Luo Chen's sword technique, and strangled Lu Yuan from all directions.
passed by the swordAt that point, the air was split with countless white marks, and the gravel on the ground was swept by the sword and turned into powder in an instant.
Lu Yuan's forward momentum continued to increase.
The indestructible golden light flows crazily under the skin, intertwining into an unshakable barrier around the body.
Thousands of sword threads pierced his body, making a sound like a heavy rain of gold and iron clashing, but not even a single white mark was left behind.
The next moment, the fist hit Chu Luochen's chest, and the sword's protective body penetrated into the porcelain pieces and suddenly exploded.
Chu Luochen spurted blood from his mouth, and was knocked backwards by the punch. Half of his body was buried in the rubble, his consciousness was blurred, and his breath was like a gossamer.
His eyes were fixed on Lu Yuan's figure, and he made an inarticulate hoarse voice.
"Impossible..."
The Luo Chen sword technique is famous for its weirdness and unpredictability, and Wan Jian Gui Chen is the most lethal technique among them.
Lu Yuan didn't avoid it at all.
Those sword shadows didn't even leave a single white mark on his body.
Lu Yuan stepped forward, from Iron Wall Fort to Cangyun Sect, from Shi Potian to Duan Cangyun, and now he beat Chu Luochen to the point of being seriously injured and on the verge of death.
Three of the four border sects have been eliminated so far.
He raised his hand, and Chu Luochen's body turned into a wreckage in the gray mist.
The Lord of Luojian Mountain, like Duan Cangyun, finally paid the price for their arrogance.
In silence, the sword formation cloud sea above Cangyun Ridge completely dissipated.
The entire mountain gate was exposed to the sun and was devastated.
Most of the sword hall collapsed, and the square was filled with lost disciples.
Lu Yuan took Duan Cangyun's waist card in his hand and scanned the ruins.
Shi Potian is dead, and Chu Luochen of Luojian Mountain and Duan Cangyun of Cangyun Sect are here to tell the truth.
The only thing left now is Feixing Valley.
Liu Xingshu is on the fourth level of the Void Realm. His cultivation level is the lowest among the four sect leaders, but he is the most cunning and the best at adapting to the wind.
However, Li Zhenyue said before that what Liu Xingshu is best at is maneuvering in the cracks.
After today, there is no gap between the two sides.
Matters in Feixing Valley can be left to the local station.
The entrance to the Cangyun Sect's treasure house is just below the ruins of the Head Sword Hall.
It can be opened with the sect leader's token as the key and spiritual consciousness as the guide.
He injected spiritual power into the token according to the guidance of the sword intent sealed in the token.
The next moment, a dull sound of machine rotation came from deep within the ruins of the sword hall.
The stone door several feet long slowly opened, and a desolate atmosphere unique to heaven, materials and earthly treasures rushed in.
Duan Cangyun has been running Cangyun Sect these years, and the savings in the treasure house are more abundant than those of Iron Wall Castle.
Rows of secret records of sword techniques, mountains of spiritual stones, and dozens of top-grade long swords made of Cangyun Black Iron, a specialty of Cangyun Ridge.
However, these things were of little use to Lu Yuan, so they could be handed over to the Ding'an Garrison for confiscation.
His consciousness swept through the treasure house, and soon he sensed a breath in the deepest part.
At the end of the treasure house is a small cold spring sealed by a formation.
An ice-blue crystal fruit is suspended in the center of the spring. Its skin is crystal clear, and its veins can be clearly seen.
